description:
Here's a description of the provided line plot, following the requested guidelines:

The plot illustrates the relationship between training steps and bits per character (BPC) for two different models during validation. The x-axis is labeled “Training Steps (x10³)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 50, with tick labels at intervals of 10. The y-axis is labeled “BPC” and has a linear scale ranging from 1.3 to 2.2, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. A black line, marked with ‘x’ symbols, represents the “SMoE Validating” data; it begins at approximately 1.7 BPC at 0 training steps, declines to approximately 1.35 BPC at 10 training steps, and then remains relatively steady around 1.3 BPC until 50 training steps, ending at approximately 1.32 BPC. A magenta line, marked with triangle symbols, represents the “SimSMoE Validating” data; it starts at 2.1 BPC at 0 training steps, declines to approximately 1.35 BPC at 10 training steps, and then remains relatively steady around 1.3 BPC until 50 training steps, ending at approximately 1.31 BPC.
